Remove ALL user interface: top HUD, left navigation, bottom bar, ALL foreground paper boards, portrait cards, character dossier, book, buttons, labels, nameplates, values, icons, frames and ALL readable writing. No new foreground characters. Entire landscape 16:9 image edge to edge, no frame, no overlay, no text, no numbers, no watermark. This must be scene art, not a screenshot with baked-in UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game object sprite atlas for the Vietnamese imperial treasury game Vạn Tuế. ONE LANDSCAPE image with EXACTLY THREE equal SQUARE CELLS in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, 3 columns x 1 row, transparent background including space around each object. Left cell: open antique carved dark wooden coin chest, restrained gold brass fittings, copper/gold coins visible spilling slightly at base. Center cell: two tied burlap rice sacks, one open with pale rice and small rice ears at base. Right cell: antique rolled debt document with rich vermilion cord and small seal, no legible writing. Each is a separate isolated centered fully visible object with 10% padding INSIDE its own cell, all same scale and consistent warm upper-left studio light. Hand-painted semi-realistic historical game illustration, elegant detailed materials matching rich jade/gold/wood palace art. Natural depth of OBJECTS allowed, no interface elements at all. No nameplates, no numbers, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no floor, no large cast shadows crossing cells, no background, no watermark. Transparent alpha, no opaque checkerboard. Exactly three objects centered at x1/6,x1/2,x5/6 of the full width. Overall aspect ratio 3:1.
